simple.meaning: פַּרְעָה (parʻâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “leadership (plural concretely, leaders).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פַּרְעָה (H6546) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:42, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Judges.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּרְעָה (H6546) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פַּרְעָה (H6546) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פַּרְעָה (parʻâh) / H6546 is traced through Deuteronomy 32:42, Judges 5:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
